name: Tsugi no Terasu
source:
One autumn day, a transfer student from a foreign country showed up in Oshi's class, a second-grader at junior high and this story's main character.
The girl with short silver hair and striking azure eyes called herself Mai.
Although her Japanese was a bit rough, her polite demeanor and elegant appearance quickly captured the attention of the entire class.
However, something about that attitude everyone loved gave the protagonist a sense of unease.

One night, on the way home from dinner with his aunt and her family, the main character hears the beautiful singing voice of a girl amidst the residential area.
Even though it was a wonderful voice, her song sounded out of tune. Intrigued, he started walking in the direction of the noise...

In an empty lot, he finds his foreign classmate singing under the moonlight.

There, the protagonist discovers a secret about Mai, and so marks the beginning of a strange school life between the two.

[Translated from the [url=https://sakuramint01.kagennotuki.com/tsugiteras/tsugi_story.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
秋日的某一天，本作主人公、初中二年级的忍所在的班上，来了一位从国外转来的学生。
少女自称玛伊，有着一头银色短发和一双令人印象深刻的湛蓝眼眸。
虽然日语还不太流利，但她彬彬有礼的举止和优雅的外表，很快便吸引了全班的目光。
然而，大家交口称赞的那种态度，却让主人公隐约觉得有些不对劲。

某天夜里，与阿姨一家吃完晚饭后，主人公在回家途中听见住宅区里传来少女优美的歌声。
声音明明十分动听，唱出来的歌却不知为何总是走调。好奇之下，他循着歌声走去…

空地上，在月光下歌唱的，正是那位外国同学。

在那里，主人公得知了玛伊的一个秘密。两人奇妙的校园生活，也由此开始。

[译自[url=https://sakuramint01.kagennotuki.com/tsugiteras/tsugi_story.html]官方网站[/url]]
